doc.summary: If the block entity is loaded on the logical client, this will update the block entity using  <ref cls="net/minecraft/world/level/block/entity/BlockEntity" method="getUpdateTag" type="(net.minecraft.core.HolderLookup.Provider)net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag">#getUpdateTag(HolderLookup.Provider)</ref> and <ref cls="net/neoforged/neoforge/common/extensions/IBlockEntityExtension" method="handleUpdateTag" type="(net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag,net.minecraft.core.HolderLookup.Provider)void">#handleUpdateTag(CompoundTag, HolderLookup.Provider)</ref>.
doc.text: If the block entity is loaded on the logical client, this will update the block entity using  <ref cls="net/minecraft/world/level/block/entity/BlockEntity" method="getUpdateTag" type="(net.minecraft.core.HolderLookup.Provider)net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag">#getUpdateTag(HolderLookup.Provider)</ref> and <ref cls="net/neoforged/neoforge/common/extensions/IBlockEntityExtension" method="handleUpdateTag" type="(net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag,net.minecraft.core.HolderLookup.Provider)void">#handleUpdateTag(CompoundTag, HolderLookup.Provider)</ref>.

doc.summary: When called on the logical server, this will update the block entity to all clients that are  tracking it using <ref cls="net/minecraft/world/level/block/entity/BlockEntity" method="getUpdateTag" type="(net.minecraft.core.HolderLookup.Provider)net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag">#getUpdateTag(HolderLookup.Provider)</ref> and  <ref cls="net/neoforged/neoforge/common/extensions/IBlockEntityExtension" method="handleUpdateTag" type="(net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag,net.minecraft.core.HolderLookup.Provider)void">#handleUpdateTag(CompoundTag, HolderLookup.Provider)</ref> at the end of the current tick.

A base class for <ref cls="net/minecraft/world/level/block/entity/BlockEntity">block entities</ref>. This provides some useful methods.
